customManagers.description: Track the ai-robots-txt release that src/data/bots.ts is generated from. Renovate bumps .botlist-version.json; .github/workflows/refresh-bot-list.yml regenerates the list once the bump lands on main. Queried structurally rather than by regex so that reformatting the file cannot silently turn this into 'no dependency found'.

packageRules.description: Non-major PRs carry the line Greptile's ignoreKeywords matches (.greptile/config.json), so Greptile reviews only major bumps
